summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing completion of the take-private acquisition of Kennedy-Wilson Holdings, Inc. by a consortium led by CEO William McMorrow, other senior executives, and Fairfax affiliates. The deal was for US$10.90 per share in cash, fully closed as of June 16, 2026. The KW Management Group retains operational control, while Fairfax holds a majority economic interest. A consortium affiliate entered a three-year US$1.3 billion term loan facility, guaranteed by Fairfax. No regulatory clock remains; the transaction is complete. Investors should monitor post-close debt servicing and Fairfax's economic exposure.
